body:
Your notes: more pug, more pomchi, keep it cartoon.
Pug: flat dark mask, big round eyes, folded ears, wrinkle lines, curly tail, stocky legs.
Pomchi: fluffy round body, ruff, upright pointy ears with pink inside, plume tail on the back.
Each card has Version: New / Today (game).

comments.text: Built round 40. Reviewer: pug 8.5, pomchi 8.5. Pomchi card: only-age-pomchi.
Done: pug nose and mouth show, rings gone. Pomchi: today's kept.

short: You kept the new pug and today's pomchi

title: Pug and pomchi: easy to recognise
